input.citation: Sevilla et al., 2022, 'Compute Trends Across Three Eras of Machine Learning'
input.source_excerpt: Table 2 reports a doubling time of roughly 6 months for the Deep Learning era, i.e. about 4x per year, not 10x.

rationale: The cited table gives ~4x/year; the claim's 10x/year is not supported by the locator. A correct audit must FLAG this.
